ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(LeadSource) = 'Broker Portal', ( ISBLANK( BrokerAgency__c ) || ISBLANK( BrokerAgent__c ) || ISBLANK( BrokerAgentMobile__c ) || ISBLANK( BrokerAgentName__c ) ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Source_Entity__c, 'Modon - Egypt')) )
